name: Robert Treat Paine Estate

dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox prints exactly 'Built | 1866, 1883-1886' with 'Architect | Henry Hobson Richardson; Frederick Law Olmsted': an existing 1866 house that Richardson and Olmsted enlarged in the 1880s. Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons, read the same day, give 'Inception 1866'. Which parts of the standing house are Richardson's was NOT established here.

note: Written 5 Sep 2026 for WP-11.3, Tranche 2, and it is the record in this cluster a reader should distrust first. No HABS survey was found. Its own principal source contradicts itself about which style it is: the Wikipedia infobox says Shingle Style and the same page's categories file it under Richardsonian Romanesque. That is exactly the boundary richardsonian-romanesque's `distinguished_from` has to hold, and this building sits on it -- a Richardson house whose stone base and arch are the manner's domestic vocabulary and whose upper walls are shingled. It is carried as `documentary` for that reason and not as a type specimen. Nothing here should be read as settling the attribution.
